column3: پردرآمدترین محصولات از نظر مجموع مبلغ فروش اینترنتی (Internet Sales) کدامند؟
column4:
WITH [sales] AS (SELECT [SalesOrderNumber], [ProductKey], [CustomerKey], [SalesTerritoryKey], [OrderDateKey], [OrderQuantity], [UnitPrice], [SalesAmount], [TotalProductCost], [DiscountAmount], [TaxAmt], [Freight], [OrderDate] FROM [dbo].[FactInternetSales]),
[product] AS (SELECT [ProductKey], [EnglishProductName] AS [ProductName], [ProductSubcategoryKey], [Color], [Size], [Weight], [ListPrice], [StandardCost], [ModelName] FROM [dbo].[DimProduct])
SELECT TOP 10 [product].[ProductName], SUM([sales].[SalesAmount]) AS [TotalSales] FROM [sales] INNER JOIN [product] ON [sales].[ProductKey] = [product].[ProductKey] GROUP BY [product].[ProductName] ORDER BY [TotalSales] DESC
column8: The question is asking for the top products by total internet sales amount.

column3: کدام دسته‌بندی محصول (Product Category) بیشترین سهم درآمد فروش اینترنتی را دارد؟
column4:
WITH [category] AS (SELECT [ProductCategoryKey], [EnglishProductCategoryName] AS [CategoryName] FROM [dbo].[DimProductCategory]),
[sales] AS (SELECT [SalesOrderNumber], [ProductKey], [CustomerKey], [SalesTerritoryKey], [OrderDateKey], [OrderQuantity], [UnitPrice], [SalesAmount], [TotalProductCost], [DiscountAmount], [TaxAmt], [Freight], [OrderDate] FROM [dbo].[FactInternetSales]),
[product] AS (SELECT [ProductKey], [EnglishProductName] AS [ProductName], [ProductSubcategoryKey], [Color], [Size], [Weight], [ListPrice], [StandardCost], [ModelName] FROM [dbo].[DimProduct]),
[subcategory] AS (SELECT [ProductSubcategoryKey], [EnglishProductSubcategoryName] AS [SubcategoryName], [ProductCategoryKey] FROM [dbo].[DimProductSubcategory])
SELECT TOP 1 [category].[CategoryName], SUM([sales].[SalesAmount]) AS [Total] FROM [sales] INNER JOIN [product] ON [sales].[ProductKey] = [product].[ProductKey] INNER JOIN [subcategory] ON [product].[ProductSubcategoryKey] = [subcategory].[ProductSubcategoryKey] INNER JOIN [category] ON [subcategory].[ProductCategoryKey] = [category].[ProductCategoryKey] GROUP BY [category].[CategoryName] ORDER BY [Total] DESC
column8: Which product category has the highest share of online sales revenue?

column3: روند فروش اینترنتی به تفکیک سال و میزان رشد (کاهش) آن نسبت به سال قبل چقدر بوده است؟
column4:
WITH [date] AS (SELECT [DateKey], [FullDateAlternateKey] AS [FullDate], [CalendarYear], [CalendarQuarter], [MonthNumberOfYear] AS [MonthNumber], [EnglishMonthName] AS [MonthName], [EnglishDayNameOfWeek] AS [DayName] FROM [dbo].[DimDate]),
[sales] AS (SELECT [SalesOrderNumber], [ProductKey], [CustomerKey], [SalesTerritoryKey], [OrderDateKey], [OrderQuantity], [UnitPrice], [SalesAmount], [TotalProductCost], [DiscountAmount], [TaxAmt], [Freight], [OrderDate] FROM [dbo].[FactInternetSales])
SELECT TOP 100 [d].[CalendarYear], SUM([s].[SalesAmount]) AS [TotalSales], LAG(SUM([s].[SalesAmount])) OVER (ORDER BY [d].[CalendarYear]) AS [PreviousYearSales], ((SUM([s].[SalesAmount]) - LAG(SUM([s].[SalesAmount])) OVER (ORDER BY [d].[CalendarYear])) / NULLIF(LAG(SUM([s].[SalesAmount])) OVER (ORDER BY [d].[CalendarYear]), 0)) * 100 AS [GrowthRate] FROM [sales] [s] INNER JOIN [date] [d] ON [s].[OrderDateKey] = [d].[DateKey] GROUP BY [d].[CalendarYear] ORDER BY [d].[CalendarYear]
